subject: SIG evidence request — kernel telemetry, KMS rotation logs, and model-audit extracts
messages:
From: Nadia Thomas <nadia.thomas@heliocorp.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelioCorp Procurement <procure@heliocorp.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire follow-up — kernel telemetry and KMS evidence

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we pull our SIG package together, our security team has a couple of targeted asks to substantiate the controls around model serving and key management. Can you help with the following items?

1) A sample of model-serving runtime telemetry (anonymized) showing request/response traces and per-request kernel-level timings for a typical inference session.
2) KMS key rotation proof: rotation timestamps, key IDs (redacted), and the rotation policy reference.
3) Cloud audit trail excerpts (CloudTrail / Audit Log) showing access to KMS and the inference hosts for a 30-day window.

If you can’t provide raw logs for privacy reasons, a redacted extract or an attestation with an attached extract would work. Our SOC team is trying to correlate time windows to control IDs in the SIG questionnaire. We’re hoping to close this by end of month — do you have availability to deliver a packet and a short call next week to walk the artifacts?

Appreciate it,
Nadia

--
Nadia Thomas
Sr. InfoSec Manager | HelioCorp
Nadia.thomas@heliocorp.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Thomas <nadia.thomas@heliocorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up — kernel telemetry and KMS evidence

Hi Nadia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Monica (security/compliance lead) and Karthik (assurance) to scope what we can share and how. Quick answers up front:

- We can provide redacted telemetry extracts showing per-request latencies and kernel-level time breakdowns (scheduling, kernel compute, memcpy).
- We can provide KMS rotation metadata (timestamps and policy references), but key material and full key IDs will be redacted.
- For audit trails, we can export Cloud audit records for the requested 30-day window with identities redacted; where necessary we’ll provide a narrative crosswalk showing how those events map to SIG control IDs.

Monica / Karthik — can you confirm: 1) the minimal redaction pattern we need for logs; 2) whether the redwood-kernel-telemetry-sample (synthetic) is sufficient, or Helio wants production traces under an NDA?

Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Nadia Thomas <nadia.thomas@heliocorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up — kernel telemetry and KMS evidence

Hi everyone — thanks, Alex. Quick compliance notes and our proposed deliverables:

Deliverables we can prepare this week:
- redacted-kms-rotation-snapshot-2027-08-01.csv (contains rotation events with key aliases and timestamps; full key IDs masked to the last 4 characters)
- redwood-kernel-telemetry-sample-2027-07.log (synthetic, but generated from production sampling to preserve realistic timing distributions; PII removed)
- sig-control-crosswalk-HelioCorp.xlsx (mapping of SIG control IDs to the artifacts above and to our SOC 2 controls)

Redaction policy: we will mask user principal identifiers and complete key IDs; we will preserve mapping tokens so Helio can validate sequence/timestamp continuity. If Helio requires raw production logs, we will require an executed NDA + evidence access agreement and a short design review on data handling.

Request for Helio: please confirm which control IDs you need correlated to timestamps (if you provide a short list we will prioritize the crosswalk). Also propose 45 minutes next Tue or Wed (US morning) for a short handoff.

Marissa / Karthik: tagging you for any legal or attestational comments.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick legal note before we ship artifacts:

- We’ll deliver redacted extracts only. Please confirm Helio is OK with masking of principal IDs and key IDs.
- If Helio prefers less redaction, we need an executed data-access addendum. I have attached a short template (see attachment: data-access-addendum-draft.docx) — if Helio signs, we can provide expanded logs under the agreed scoped conditions.

Nadia — can Helio sign the addendum, or do you prefer we proceed with the redacted sample set?

Thanks,
Marissa

Nadia — attaching the initial packet per our plan. High-level notes:

- Attached: redacted-kms-rotation-snapshot-2027-08-01.csv, redwood-kernel-telemetry-sample-2027-07.log, sig-control-crosswalk-HelioCorp.xlsx
- The kernel telemetry is a 1:100 sample of production traces with all user identifiers removed. Column headers include: timestamp, request_id (mapped token), scheduler_us, compute_us, memcpy_us, total_latency_us.
- The KMS snapshot lists rotation events for aliases used by Helio-related tenants; full key materials and full key IDs are masked to the pattern: ****-xxxx (last four chars visible).
- We included a short crosswalk tying the telemetry timestamps back to SIG control IDs SC-1.1 (logging), CR-2.3 (key management), and OP-4.2 (access review). If you want additional control mappings, send the control list and we’ll extend the crosswalk.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and propose a 45-minute call this week to walk the artifacts. If Helio needs less-redacted data, we’ll exchange the addendum as Marissa suggested.

Best,
Alex

Attachments: redacted-kms-rotation-snapshot-2027-08-01.csv (CSV, 12KB), redwood-kernel-telemetry-sample-2027-07.log (TXT, 180KB), sig-control-crosswalk-HelioCorp.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)
